descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Contract
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Dezvoltare de software și Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT
Position Overview: 
 We are looking for a Senior Java Developer to play a key role in the design, development, and maintenance of the high-performance backend systems. This role requires a strong technical foundation and the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and integrated services.
 Responsibilities within the team: 
Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to gather requirements, design, and implement new features
Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable Java applications that handle millions of daily transactions
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code, adhering to best practices and coding standards
Work as part of a team, conduct code reviews, provide constructive feedback and collaborate with others
Identify bottlenecks and bugs, and devise solutions to mitigate and address these issues
Stay up-to-date with the latest Java technologies and frameworks (Spring Boot, Hibernate, JPA preferred)
 Facing the challenges of the role requires: 
A seasoned Java developer with relevant experience in back-end and web development
Experience with: Java 21, SpringBoot, Hibernate
An expert in object-oriented design and development principles
Possess a deep understanding of relational databases and SQL
Proven experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
Adept with Git for version control and collaboration
A strong communicator with excellent collaboration and teamwork skills
Passionate about sharing knowledge, mentoring, and fostering a culture of continuous learning
A problem-solver with a proactive and results-oriented mindset
Highly motivated with a keen eye for detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work
